company: Family Comfort & AC Repair Hummelstown Group

reviews.text: Outstanding workmanship on our new heat pump installation! The crew arrived right on time, worked diligently, and ensured every vent was properly balanced. Our home has never felt this comfortable. Friendly, expert, and trustworthy technicians!
reviews.author: Jericho B.

reviews.text: Compared to the previous installation we had done a few years back, this job was more efficient and required less time with the technicians completing everything in under four hours.
reviews.author: FERNANDA C.

reviews.text: The quote we received was competitive, and the installation itself took most of the day, but they overlooked cleaning up some debris afterward which needed addressing.
reviews.author: JUNIOR C.
